text: 10 OVERDOSAGE To date, there has been limited experience with overdosage of pravastatin. If an overdose occurs, it should be treated symptomatically with laboratory monitoring and supportive measures should be instituted as required.
10 OVERDOSAGE No specific antidotes for pravastatin are known. Contact Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) for latest recommendations.
